name: branches
description: Branch of a company: a location with its own business time zone, assigned members and, later, devices.
lifecycle: Created ACTIVE; archived rather than deleted so references remain valid.

columns.Meaning: Backend-generated immutable branch UUID; public resource ID.
Branch name, unique among the company's active branches regardless of case.
IANA scheduling zone derived atomically from a confirmed map point. Legacy branches retain their existing zone until location selection; an explicit device zone can override this branch zone.
ACTIVE branches are usable; ARCHIVED branches are retained for references.
Optimistic concurrency token incremented once per successful change.
PostgreSQL-clock instant of the latest change; not audit history.
Confirmed branch map point, storing latitude and longitude rounded to six decimals. The API derives time_zone from geographic boundaries; clients cannot override the zone of a selected location.
columns.Null meaning: No map point confirmed; preserve the existing legacy time zone until selection.

columns.Meaning: Full branch address entered by an authorized company administrator. Required when a map point is selected; never sent to a geocoding service or treated as independently verified.

constraints.Purpose: An optional address cannot be blank.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: A branch belongs to an existing company.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((location IS NULL) OR ((address IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim((address)::text)) > 0))))
constraints.Purpose: A branch with a confirmed map point also has a full address.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((location IS NULL) OR ((location ?& ARRAY['latitude'::text, 'longitude'::text]) AND (jsonb_typeof((location -> 'latitude'::text)) = 'number'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((location -> 'longitude'::text)) = 'number'::text) AND ((((location ->> 'latitude'::text))::numeric >= ('-90'::integer)::numeric) AND (((location ->> 'latitude'::text))::numeric <= (90)::numeric)) AND ((((location ->> 'longitude'::text))::numeric >= ('-180'::integer)::numeric) AND (((location ->> 'longitude'::text))::numeric <= (180)::numeric)))))
constraints.Purpose: Selected map points carry numeric latitude and longitude within geographic bounds.
A selected location is a structured map point.
Time zone has the IANA identifier shape.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX branches_company_active_name_unique ON public.branches USING btree (company_id, lower((name)::text)) WHERE (status = 'ACTIVE'::"BranchStatus")
constraints.Purpose: Active branch names are unique within a company, ignoring case, including racing creations.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX branches_company_id_id_key ON public.branches USING btree (company_id, id)
constraints.Purpose: Tenant key that tenant references target.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX branches_company_status_name_idx ON public.branches USING btree (company_id, status, name)
constraints.Purpose: Supports listing a company's branches by state and name.
